command:
set -eu
umask 077
credential_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory-db.env.tmp.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$credential_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
app_password=[REDACTED] rand -hex 24)
printf '%s\n' 'DB_HOST=localhost' 'DB_PORT=3306' 'DB_NAME=inventory' 'DB_USER=inventory_app' "DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED] > "$credential_tmp"
mariadb --protocol=socket <<SQL
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS inventory CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory.items (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  sku VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  quantity INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_items_sku (sku)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'inventory_app'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY [REDACTED];
ALTER USER 'inventory_app'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY [REDACTED];
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON inventory.* TO 'inventory_app'@'localhost';
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
SQL
install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$credential_tmp" /etc/inventory-db.env
rm -f "$credential_tmp"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
unset app_password
printf 'inventory configuration applied\n'
